info.name: CloudQuery Platform OpenAPI Spec admin apps API

items.docs: Idempotently upsert a list of apps by name within the caller's tenant. For each name, returns its existing app id (if the name already exists) or a freshly-generated one (if newly created). Duplicate names in the request are deduplicated server-side. Intended primarily for service-to-service use from accessory writers that materialize app memberships.
